dedupe_keys.name: historic coastal landfills project datasets scripts and interactive maps of historic landfills on or next to crown estate coastal property in england a future without rubbish cic

description: This project, carried out for the community interest company A Future Without Rubbish, screens historic landfills on the coast that lie on or next to property of the Crown Estate. The repository brings together the datasets, Python helper scripts, reports and published outputs: an interactive map of historic coastal landfills at Crown Estate sites, a more detailed second-level map for Norfolk, and charts showing how many sites remain as successive waste criteria are applied. Everything is free to download from GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 licence, and the maps can be viewed in a browser. Caveats: the README does not name the underlying landfill records, the dates or the exact criteria, so the source data and filters need checking in the repository, and it is a small project whose maintenance status is unknown. Coverage is the coast of England, with detail for Norfolk. Simulation uses: identifying legacy waste sites exposed to coastal erosion, storm surge and sea level rise, where release of waste is a hazard for the waste sector and the coast. Related records: the Environment Agency historic landfill sites (data-ea-historic-landfill-sites) are the national inventory of such sites.
